title: kaizen auto-handoff dxm event payload
description: Schema for the payload of auto_handoff.requested dxm events. Written once per session at first threshold crossing.

pct.description: Current context % at fire time (may exceed 100 if limit is mis-set).

tokens.description: Absolute current_tokens at fire time (None when JSONL unavailable).

peak_tokens.description: Max tokens seen across all assistant turns this session.
